candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500, propagating as a gateway error.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db-pool, redis, config) not observable from gateway telemetry; only the 500 propagation is established.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway checkout 502s caused by order service returning 500 on /v1/orders; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Gateway-side evidence bounds the fault to the order call, but order-internal cause is not yet observed.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the 500 on POST /v1/orders to determine the underlying fault
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
